topic: Complex Expression Parsing to Avoid Bugs in C
explanation: In advanced C programming, understanding how complex expressions are parsed according to operator precedence and associativity is crucial for writing correct and efficient code. Mastery of expression parsing enables developers to predict evaluation order, avoid subtle bugs, and optimize performance when combining multiple operators, especially in macro definitions, pointer manipulations, and callback mechanisms. Recognizing how C interprets intricate expressions ensures precise control over side effects and evaluation sequences in high-level systems programming.
keywords: Operator Precedence, Expression Evaluation Order, C Operator Associativity, Complex Expression Parsing
